Research record (spec enumerations, part 2 of 2: sections (4)–(7)). All findings are based on `origin/main` @ `083620b0`.

### (4) CI-parity collapse

`tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` has **37** top-level test functions on origin/main (not 32). Verdicts:

KEEP (bug-anchored, executes workflow shell, sweeps every workflow, or the sole delegation invariant): 1 `test_both_lanes_delegate_to_the_shared_gate_workflow` (:162, THE anti-drift invariant); 7 `test_mutation_selector_skips_pre_gate_trees…` (:312, runs the selector shell); 8 `test_degradation_step_runs_only_the_present_test_files` (:370, bugs d93e/5bc6); 12 `test_shared_pytest_job_has_incident_timeout` (:791, 6-hour hang cost has no other owner); 13-15 pytest-invocation sweep + per-test hang guard (:864-963, ticket 89d5); 16 `…flag_free_and_governed_by_the_ini` (:966, bug 3fa7); 17 `…fails_fast_on_worker_crash…` (:1020, bug 3fa7); 18 `test_no_drift_script_gate_is_verified_only_in_branch_ci` (:1066, auto-derived script parity); 19 `test_optionality_contract_gates_the_verified_path` (:1086) REWRITTEN to parametrize over every `uses: ./.github/workflows/_*.yml` job in `gerrit-verify.yaml` (6 jobs, `:220-308`), asserting `with.gerrit-refspec == "${{ inputs.GERRIT_REFSPEC }}"` and that a push/PR lane `uses` the same reusable — this subsumes 4 and 5; 21 `test_repo_policy_nodes_run_only_in_the_existing_primary_cell` (:1221) minus the job-set snapshot at `:1231`; 22 `test_platform_compat_suite_covers_the_core_os_sensitive_seams` (:1288, silent macOS coverage drop); 23 `test_macos_default_suite_lane_passes_when_platform_compat_collects_nothing` (:1336, runs the lane's real shell); 24-27 optionality-suite/loop guards (:1406-1536, ticket hominoid-awestruck-goshawk, story 271c); 28 `test_branch_sensitive_precommit_hooks_skipped_in_ci` (bug pillared-doddering-fawn); 29 `test_ci_redundant_hooks_skipped_in_precommit` (ticket ecumenical-equal-sidewinder); 30-34, 37 Makefile POSIX-dash closure tests (:1812-1922; a portability property with no other owner).

DELETE: 2 `test_matrix_keeps_every_test_tier_but_collects_coverage_once` (matrix snapshot; a coverage double-run is visible, not silent); 3 `test_diff_coverage_step…` (report-only step's shape/version pin); 4 `test_scanner_gate_uses_one_reusable…` and 5 `test_mutation_gate_uses_one_reusable…` (vote.needs → the script; refspec → rewritten 19); 6 `test_mutation_workflows_are_bounded_and_publish_results` (schedule/artifact config snapshot); 9 `test_mutation_reusable_expands_selector_json…` (:463-766, a 300-line dict-equality snapshot of `_mutation.yml`; vote.needs → script, refspec → 19, secret paths → zizmor in `make lint`); 10 `test_shared_gate_signatures_live_in_the_reusable` (hand-maintained list; a gate removal is a reviewed diff of the one reusable both lanes call, and 18 auto-catches script gates); 11 `test_documentation_gate_signatures_live_in_the_shared_action` (duplicate of `tests/unit/test_gerrit_docs_only.py:31-53`); 20 `test_repo_policy_nodes_partition_the_default_selection_exactly` (:1208, hard-codes node ids that S3/S4 delete: `test_comment_hygiene_guard::test_the_real_tree_is_clean`, five `test_check_config_reads_heldout` nodes, `test_tests_import_convention::test_no_tests_rooted_imports…`); 35 `test_makefile_lint_runs_both_config_gates` and 36 `test_ci_runs_the_config_gates_through_make_lint_not_a_duplicate_step` (wiring → the S3 census). Net: 37 → 23 functions; also set `_OPTIONALITY_SUITE_ITEM_COUNT` (`:1132`) from 10 to 9 when S4 deletes one `test_core_optionality.py` test (order S2 before S4).

Survivor between `test_verify_gate_parity.py` and the script: **the script**. It already runs in CI (`_build-and-test.yml:145-152`) but NOT in `make lint`; add `python scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` after `Makefile:439` (the CI step stays; the ~50 ms double run is accepted because workflow files are out of E10a's scope). Its remaining assertion (`scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py:143-165`): `vote.needs` ⊇ every job of `test.yml`/`optionality.yml`/`verify-identity.yml`/`prompt-eval.yml` minus `EXCLUDED_JOBS`, plus `classify`/`docs-only`. `test_verify_gate_parity.py` keeps its 7 synthetic tests (`:53-109`).

### (5) Import-convention scans → ruff (`ruff==0.16.3`, `pyproject.toml:257`; verified on the venv's 0.16.2)

Current `[tool.ruff.lint]` (`pyproject.toml:437-495`) selects no TID codes; `ignore` must stay the RUF trio and no `extend-ignore` (`tests/unit/test_ruff_ratchet.py:76-107`), so TID goes in `select` + `per-file-ignores` only. TID251 and TID253 are each ONE global list toggled per path, so at most one scoped rule per code can be expressed.

| test module | rule | ruff expression or STAYS |
|---|---|---|
| `tests/unit/test_tests_import_convention.py::test_no_tests_rooted_imports_anywhere_under_tests` (:57-76, bug a371) | no `tests.`-rooted import anywhere under tests/ | FOLD: `select += ["TID251"]`; `[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-tidy-imports.banned-api]` `"tests".msg = "tests.-rooted imports resolve only with the repo root on sys.path, which the bare pytest console script (make test, CI) does not provide; import same-directory helpers by bare name (bug a371)"`. Parent matching covers `import tests.x`, `from tests import x`, `from tests.x import y`, and in-function imports (verified). Keep `test_audit_page_modules_collect_under_bare_pytest` (the bug's repro) |
| `tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py::test_no_core_module_imports_heavy_stack_at_module_scope` (:131-148) | no module-scope heavy import under src/rebar except `_engine` | FOLD: `select += ["TID253"]`; `[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-tidy-imports]` `banned-module-level-imports = ["langchain","langgraph","langchain_anthropic","langchain_openai","langchain_mcp_adapters","langfuse","anthropic","deepagents","opentelemetry","pydantic_ai","httpx","tree_sitter","tree_sitter_language_pack","hcl2","lark"]`; per-file-ignores: `"src/rebar/_engine/**" = ["TID253"]`, extend `:536` to `"tests/**" = ["T201", "TID253"]` and `:578` to `"scripts/**" = ["T201", "TID253"]`. Keep `test_lean_workflow_runtime_pulls_no_heavy_stack`, reading its list from pyproject via `tomllib` so the list has one source. Both rules are green on the current tree (verified with `--config` overrides) |
| `tests/unit/test_no_reducer_engine_support_cycle.py` (71) | reducer must not module-import `rebar._engine_support` | STAYS: TID253 is claimed by the heavy-stack rule and its scope (all src) differs from this one (reducer only); per-file-ignores cannot scope two lists under one code |
| `tests/unit/test_scripts_import_convention.py` (184, bug 291e) | sibling import preceded by a `__file__`-derived `sys.path.insert` | STAYS: order/derivation condition |
| `tests/unit/workflow/test_executor_tripwire.py::test_executor_imports_no_scheduler_or_retry_lib`, `test_map_fanout_is_the_sole_concurrency_module` | asyncio/threading/retry libs banned in 2 files, required in 1 | STAYS: file-scoped ban + positive presence; TID251 is claimed |
| `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/mutate/test_dependency_direction.py` (63) | reconciler imports only `ticket_reducer`/`event_append` engine seams | STAYS: bare engine names are legitimate elsewhere; TID251 claimed |
| `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_backend_neutrality.py`, `test_jira_family_boundary_heldout.py`, `test_rich_text_seam_heldout.py` ADF allowlists | scoped vendor-import bans with allowlists | STAYS: scoped, substring/AST-mixed, and the reconciler epic renames the package |

### (6) Bug-anchored oracles and red proofs

Red proof: `tests/scripts/test_check_config_reads_red_proof.py` (the only `*_red_proof.py`) — untouched. Modules in E10's touch set whose docstring cites a bug id (33; all KEEP — their test functions survive every merge/rename; nothing bug-anchored is deleted): `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_close_gate_subtree.py` (ferric-jet-scorpion); compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
The test suite (about 19,200 nodes, 20 to 25 minutes for `make verify`) carries four classes of tests that assert nothing about behaviour. 37 modules (7,000 LOC, 486 nodes) pin one-time module splits as permanent invariants: re-export identity, "leaf" import shape, LOC floors, "shim no longer reachable"; 39 real behaviour tests are trapped inside them. `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` (1,890 LOC, 37 tests) re-asserts workflow config snapshots that its own docstring says collapsed into one reusable workflow, and duplicates `scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` and `tests/unit/test_gerrit_docs_only.py`. 30 modules re-run a `scripts/check_*.py` gate over the real tree, or grep the Makefile for its invocation, although `make lint` (`Makefile:266-439`) already runs the script in CI. Two whole-tree AST import scans duplicate what ruff's `flake8-tidy-imports` (TID251/TID253, ruff 0.16.3) expresses natively; the remaining scans cannot be expressed and stay. `pytest-split` is pinned but `.test_durations` is git-ignored, so no duration profile exists. The operator approved retiring these classes (2026-09-06). Every verdict is enumerated per file and per test node, with node arithmetic, on origin/main 083620b0 in this epic's first two comments (the held-out pair list is the first comment on the sibling merge epic). This epic touches only `tests/`, `scripts/`, `pyproject.toml`, `Makefile`, `.gitignore`, `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, and `docs/`, so it runs in parallel with the code epics.

Ratchet note: this epic creates no `tests/_*.py` helper, no check script, no workflow step, and no autouse fixture, so `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` reports `new=0` throughout; `--update-stale` is not run here.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The 24 seam/split guard modules beyond the 13 already classified are deleted and every trapped behaviour test collects at its named destination; 301 nodes deleted, 39 moved, 149 kept, reconciled from before/after collect runs. Checked in the seam story.
- [ ] `test_ci_workflow_parity.py` keeps 25 bug-anchored or shell-executing tests plus one refspec test rewritten to parametrize over the six reusable-workflow jobs, the 11 named snapshot and duplicate tests are deleted, and `scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` runs from `make lint`. Checked in the parity story against its per-test verdict table.
- [ ] Every `scripts/check_*.py` has exactly one owner: `make lint` runs it (the three CI-only scripts are added there) and no pytest module re-runs it against the real tree; `tests/unit/test_make_lint_hygiene_wiring.py` is the single wiring census over all 28 lint-target scripts. Checked in the single-owner story.
- [ ] `TID251` (no `tests.`-rooted imports) and `TID253` (no module-level heavy-stack imports outside `src/rebar/_engine`) are enforced by ruff with a recorded red proof, and the two AST scans they replace are deleted. Checked in the ruff story.
- [ ] `.test_durations` is committed, generated by `pytest --store-durations --clean-durations` over the default selection; every key is a node id that selection collects, and the count of collected nodes with no key is recorded on the durations story with each such node's cause (pytest-split 0.11.0 writes a key per test report with a positive duration, skips included, so the target is 0). Accepted by pre-commit and documented in `docs/local-dev-env.md`. Checked in the durations story.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0 after each story.

## Child decomposition
- S1 delete the seam/split guard modules and move their behaviour tests: criterion 1.
- S2 collapse the CI-parity guards: criterion 2; depends on S1.
- S3 one owner per `scripts/check_*.py`: criterion 3; depends on S2.
- S4 fold the two expressible import scans into ruff: criterion 4; depends on S3.
- S5 record per-test durations once: criterion 5; depends on S4.
